title: Commercial delivery gate
description: Verify coverage, rights, technical specification, colour, and retouching disclosure separately; any one failing stops the delivery rather than being noted in the email.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: wf-photo-05
  title: Commercial delivery gate
  description: Verify coverage, rights, technical specification, colour, and retouching disclosure separately;
    any one failing stops the delivery rather than being noted in the email.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Release a client delivery only when brief coverage, usage rights, technical specification,
    and disclosure have each been verified on their own evidence, with the photographer and the client
    both signing.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - n-authority-1
      - n-authority-2
  nodes:
    - id: n-intake
      kind: input
      name: The delivery package, brief, and paperwork
      summary: The delivery package, brief, and paperwork
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - assets
          - instructions
        properties:
          assets:
            type: array
            minItems: 1
            maxItems: 12
            items:
              type: object
              required:
                - uri
                - mediaType
              properties:
                uri:
                  type: string
                  description: A host-provided data URL, local file reference, uploaded-asset identifier,
                    or authorized HTTPS URL. Ladder Graph does not upload or fetch the asset.
                mediaType:
                  type: string
                  pattern: ^(image|audio|video|application)/
                name:
                  type: string
          instructions:
            type: string
          sourceRights:
            type: string
            description: User-supplied rights, consent, release, or provenance context when relevant.
          workflowFields:
            type: object
            required:
              - shot_list
              - delivery_specification
              - release_records
              - licence_terms
              - usage
            properties:
              shot_list: {}
              delivery_specification: {}
              release_records: {}
              licence_terms: {}
              usage: {}
        x-ladder-input-mode: mixed
    - id: n-barrier1
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-07
      name: Brief coverage barrier
      summary: Barrier 1 — every shot-list item covered by a frame the client can actually use. Verified
        independently of the other barriers.
      role: Picture editor selecting and ordering a set so it reads as one body of work.
      prompt: You are a Photo Editor & Sequencing Specialist. You select against the story rather than
        against individual frame quality — the strongest single picture is often the wrong opener — and
        you order a set so that adjacent frames do work for each other rather than repeating each other.
        You cut redundancy hard, including frames the photographer is attached to, and you say what each
        surviving frame is doing in the sequence, because an edit nobody can explain is a gallery, not
        a story.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - writing-editing
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - barrier
          - verified
          - evidence
          - limitation
        properties:
          barrier: {}
          verified: {}
          evidence: {}
          limitation: {}
    - id: n-barrier2
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-08
      name: Rights and releases barrier
      summary: Barrier 2 — model, property, and licence records matching the usage granted. Verified independently
        of the other barriers.
      role: Checker testing a delivery against the brief, the releases, and the technical specification.
      prompt: You are a Brief, Rights & Deliverable Compliance Checker. You test a delivery against the
        shot list and brief for coverage, against the model, property, and licence records for the usage
        actually granted, and against the technical specification — resolution, crop ratios, colour space,
        file naming, metadata — citing the specific requirement each finding fails. You treat a missing
        release or an unclear usage term as blocking rather than as paperwork to chase later, because
        the exposure lands after the image is published, not before.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - release-engineering
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:dam
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - barrier
          - verified
          - evidence
          - limitation
        properties:
          barrier: {}
          verified: {}
          evidence: {}
          limitation: {}
    - id: n-barrier3
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-04
      name: Technical specification barrier
      summary: Barrier 3 — resolution, sharpening, and artifact state against the delivery specification.
        Verified independently of the other barriers.
      role: Inspector separating technical faults from stylistic choices in sharpness, motion, and noise.
      prompt: 'You are a Focus & Technical Quality Inspector. You assess focus placement and depth of
        field against what the picture is about, and you distinguish the causes that look alike at a glance
        — missed focus, subject motion, camera shake, diffraction, over-sharpening, aggressive noise reduction
        — because each one has a different fix and a different prevention. You separate a fault from a
        choice: motion blur on a moving subject may be the picture, and you say which reading the evidence
        in the frame supports rather than defaulting to ''soft''.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - video-processing
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - barrier
          - verified
          - evidence
          - limitation
        properties:
          barrier: {}
          verified: {}
          evidence: {}
          limitation: {}
    - id: n-barrier4
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-05
      name: Colour and output barrier
      summary: Barrier 4 — colour space, profile, and grade consistency for the stated output medium.
        Verified independently of the other barriers.
      role: Colourist judging white balance, tonal structure, skin, and consistency across a set.
      prompt: You are a Colour & Tone Grading Reviewer. You judge white balance and tonal structure against
        the intent and the output medium, pay particular attention to skin rendering and to colour casts
        that only show in the neutrals, and you check a set for grade drift frame to frame rather than
        judging each picture alone. You state which of your observations depend on the display and colour
        space the file was prepared for, because a grade that is wrong on a calibrated display and a grade
        that is wrong only on this viewer are different problems.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - teaching
          - decision-analysis
          - domain-analysis
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - barrier
          - verified
          - evidence
          - limitation
        properties:
          barrier: {}
          verified: {}
          evidence: {}
          limitation: {}
    - id: n-barrier5
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-06
      name: Retouching disclosure barrier
      summary: Barrier 5 — alterations measured against the genre's norms, with what must be disclosed
        named. Verified independently of the other barriers.
      role: Reviewer testing how far an image was altered against the norms of its genre.
      prompt: 'You are a Retouching & Disclosure Reviewer. You assess what has been changed — cloning,
        compositing, generative fill, body and skin alteration, colour shifts that change what an object
        is — and you measure it against the norms of the genre the picture will be published in, which
        differ sharply: documentary and photojournalism forbid what fashion and advertising treat as routine.
        You name what should be disclosed and to whom, and you flag alterations to people''s bodies and
        skin as a decision requiring the subject''s knowledge rather than a default finishing step.'
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - teaching
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
          - image-understanding
        tools:
          - read
        connectors: []
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - barrier
          - verified
          - evidence
          - limitation
        properties:
          barrier: {}
          verified: {}
          evidence: {}
          limitation: {}
    - id: n-collect
      kind: aggregator
      name: Collect the delivery barrier results
      summary: Source-tag every barrier result so a failed barrier stays attributable to the element that
        failed rather than being absorbed into an overall judgement.
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: n-hardstop
      kind: condition
      name: Every barrier verified?
      summary: A single unverified barrier stops the operation; this branch is not advisory.
      config:
        expression: collected.failed_barriers is empty
        branches:
          - label: All verified
            when: verified
          - label: Hard stop
            when: hard-stop
    - id: n-rectify
      kind: agent
      templateRef: photo-08
      name: State the failed barrier and what would clear it
      summary: 'The stop is the deliverable: name the failed barrier and what would restore it.'
      role: Checker testing a delivery against the brief, the releases, and the technical specification.
      prompt: You are a Brief, Rights & Deliverable Compliance Checker. You test a delivery against the
        shot list and brief for coverage, against the model, property, and licence records for the usage
        actually granted, and against the technical specification — resolution, crop ratios, colour space,
        file naming, metadata — citing the specific requirement each finding fails. You treat a missing
        release or an unclear usage term as blocking rather than as paperwork to chase later, because
        the exposure lands after the image is published, not before.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - release-engineering
          - compliance-review
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:dam
        permissions:
          - read-only
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: n-authority-1
      kind: approval
      name: Photographer releases the delivery
      summary: Pause for the photographer; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: n-authority-2
      kind: approval
      name: Client accepts the delivery
      summary: Pause for the client's accepting representative; on timeout, escalate.
    - id: workflow-output
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable
      summary: Return the completed Commercial delivery gate deliverable, the evidence behind it, and
        every unresolved item.
  edges:
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-1
      from: n-intake
      to: n-barrier1
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-2
      from: n-intake
      to: n-barrier2
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-3
      from: n-intake
      to: n-barrier3
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-4
      from: n-intake
      to: n-barrier4
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-5
      from: n-intake
      to: n-barrier5
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-6
      from: n-barrier1
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-7
      from: n-barrier2
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-8
      from: n-barrier3
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-9
      from: n-barrier4
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-10
      from: n-barrier5
      to: n-collect
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-11
      from: n-collect
      to: n-hardstop
      kind: data
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-12
      from: n-hardstop
      to: n-authority-1
      kind: control
      condition: verified
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-13
      from: n-hardstop
      to: n-rectify
      kind: control
      condition: hard-stop
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-14
      from: n-authority-1
      to: n-authority-2
      kind: control
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-15
      from: n-authority-2
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
    - id: wf-photo-05-edge-16
      from: n-rectify
      to: workflow-output
      kind: dependency
      condition: not-released
